'''''Cutandia maritima''''' is a species of herb in the family [[Poaceae]] (true grasses).<ref>{{Cite web|title=''Cutandia maritima'' (L.) Barbey - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/5810336|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Cutandia maritima'' (Cutandia Grass) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/POAC/Cutandia_maritima.php|access-date=2022-02-15|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref> It is native to southern Europe, North Africa, the [[Canary Islands]] and Western Asia.<ref name=POWO/>
